verdict.rationale: Background automation, such as scheduled monitoring or recurring filings, is a fair question for an IP-operations service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only manual online filing procedures, database search, guidance and advisory services. None of it documents user-configurable automations that run on their own in the background. The single probe shows keyless access is denied and says nothing about automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
